titulo: GTA 6 Developers Are About To Do Something Historic
texto: Workers at GTA 6 developer Rockstar will soon get to vote on recognizing a union. The union, IWGB Union at Rockstar, is for Rockstar's UK-based developers. Rockstar North, based in Edinburgh, Scotland, is one of Rockstar's biggest outfits in the UK, and the lead developer on GTA 6. The negotiating process between the union and Rockstar management took months, and the union, if recognized, would give workers a stronger seat at the table for key issues like pay and bonuses, overtime, generative AI policies, work-from-home setups, and situations involving layoffs. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=klc0fQmAL6k The IWGB Rockstar Game Workers Union would become the largest in the UK video game sector, if it's voted in. titulo: GTA 6 File Size Revealed, And It’s Massive
texto: Ahead of the game's release in November, GTA 6' s file size has been revealed, and it is massive. PlayStation Game Size reports that the $80 standard edition will take up 210GB of storage capacity. Size details for the $100 Ultimate Edition--which includes a ton of content not in the regular version--were not made available. We also don't know the Xbox Series X|S file size, but it's likely around the same. As announced previously, preloading for GTA 6 begins on November 12, which is good news considering the game is massive in terms of its file size. People will no doubt have to delete other content to fit the game on the PS5 or Xbox Series X|S.
